verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a registrar, since it stores account and WHOIS contact data. The evidence only shows that Cloudflare stores the authentic WHOIS record and redacts it publicly. Nothing documents letting users choose the region or residency where that data is stored, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
